name: CMSB Reservierung
author: CMS-Buttler

sections.description:
CMSB Reservierung adds an online table reservation workflow to WordPress. Guests can select a date, time, room or area, party size and an available table. Restaurant teams can manage rooms, outdoor areas, tables, opening hours, reservation rules, email templates and bookings directly in WordPress.

Included features:

  • Frontend reservation form via the [cmsb_reservierung] shortcode.
  • Room and outdoor area management.
  • Visual table plan editor with grid, scale, walls, pillars, obstacles and tables.
  • Opening hours with optional breaks.
  • Table capacity rules for under-occupied tables.
  • Internal table blocking duration for reservation availability.
  • Admin reservation list and calendar view.
  • Email templates for reservation communication.
  • Basic design settings for the frontend form.
  • CSV export for reservations.
  • Privacy settings and automatic anonymization of older reservation data.

This WordPress.org version is fully functional.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or install it from the WordPress.org plugin directory.
  2. Activate CMSB Reservierung.
  3. Open CMSB Reservierung in the WordPress admin area.
  4. Create the reservation page with the setup button or add [cmsb_reservierung] to an existing page.
  5. Add rooms, outdoor areas and tables, then adjust opening hours and reservation settings.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require an external service?

No. This WordPress.org package does not connect to external services for its included reservation features.

Can I use more than one room or outdoor area?

Yes. The included room and area management is available.

Can I draw a table plan?

Yes. The included table plan editor supports a grid, scale settings, tables, walls, pillars, obstacles, doors, counters and labels.

Where do I place the reservation form?

Add the shortcode [cmsb_reservierung] to any page.
